newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Caltex sees 6 mths to June improving.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Caltex sees 6 mths to June improving.

text.p: Petrol refiner and marketer Caltex Australia Ltd said on Wednesday that it expected its performance in the six months to June 30 to be better than the final half of calendar 1996, but below its result in the first half of 1996.

"The directors believe that the six months to June 1997 will be better than the six months to December 1996, but will not be as good as the six months to June 1996," Caltex said in a statement accompanying its annual profit result.
"Directors anticipate that dividends declared in the next 12 months will be fully franked," it said.
Caltex said net profit in calendar 1996 rose 36 percent to A$57.70 million, including an extraordinary profit of A$10.55 million. Operating profit rose 12 percent to A$43.65 million.
The final dividend was cut to 14 cents fully franked from 22 cents fully franked a year ago. --Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
